"""One-off current-snapshot investigation, not a pipeline dependency."""
import gzip
import hashlib
import json
import math
import re
import subprocess
import unicodedata
from pathlib import Path
from bangla_dh.paths import PROJECT_ROOT, write_json, hash_outputs
from bangla_dh.usage_metric import utf16_index

root = PROJECT_ROOT / "data/usage-metric-dataset"
paths = sorted(root.glob("sessions/*/*"))
packages = [json.loads(gzip.decompress(p.read_bytes())) for p in paths]
normal = lambda s: unicodedata.normalize("NFC", s)
words = lambda s: [w for w in re.split('[ \n\t]', s) if w]

def segment(values):
    values = sorted(set(values))
    dll = PROJECT_ROOT / 'work/usage-score-probe/Segment.dll'
    r = subprocess.run(['dotnet', str(dll)], input=json.dumps(values), capture_output=True, text=True, encoding='utf-8', check=True)
    return dict(zip(values, json.loads(r.stdout)))

full = segment(normal(s) for x in packages for p in x['prompts'] for s in (p['target_text'], p['final_text']))
all_words = set()
prepared = []
for x in packages:
    prows = []
    for p in x['prompts']:
        if not p['measured']:
            continue
        target = normal(p['target_text'])
        attempted = target if p['end_reason'] == 'enter' else ''.join(full[target][:p['attempted_units']])
        final = normal(p['final_text'])
        all_words.update(words(attempted))
        all_words.update(words(final))
        shown = next(b['seq'] for b in x['boundaries'] if b['kind']=='prompt-shown' and b.get('prompt_order')==p['order'])
        end = next(b['seq'] for b in x['boundaries'] if b['kind']=='prompt-ended' and b.get('prompt_order')==p['order'])
        firsts, edited, text = {}, set(), ''
        for e in x['text_events']:
            if not shown < e['seq'] < end or e['op']=='selection':
                continue
            a, b = utf16_index(text,e['start']), utf16_index(text,e['end'])
            if e['removed'] and e['source'] in ('native-key','undo','mouse'):
                current = text.split(' ')
                for index in range(text[:a].count(' '),text[:b].count(' ')+1):
                    edited.add(index)
                    firsts.setdefault(index, current[index] if index<len(current) else '')
            text = text[:a]+e['inserted']+text[b:]
            for index,w in enumerate(text.split(' ')[:-1]):
                firsts.setdefault(index,w)
        all_words.update(normal(w) for w in firsts.values())
        prows.append((p,attempted,final,firsts,edited))
    prepared.append(prows)
units = segment(all_words | {''})
units.update(full)

def graphemes(text):
    text = normal(text)
    if text in units:
        return units[text]
    # Attempted strings are prefixes at an already established cluster boundary.
    for whole, clusters in full.items():
        if whole.startswith(text):
            prefix, found = '', []
            for cluster in clusters:
                if len(prefix) == len(text):
                    return found
                prefix += cluster
                found.append(cluster)
            if prefix == text:
                return found
    raise ValueError('unsegmented value')

def align(a,b):
    prior=[(i,0) for i in range(len(b)+1)]
    for i,aa in enumerate(a,1):
        row=[(i,0)]
        for j,bb in enumerate(b,1):
            candidates=[(prior[j-1][0]+(aa!=bb),prior[j-1][1]+(aa==bb)),(prior[j][0]+1,prior[j][1]),(row[-1][0]+1,row[-1][1])]
            row.append(min(candidates,key=lambda x:(x[0],-x[1])))
        prior=row
    return prior[-1]

results=[]
for x,prows in zip(packages,prepared):
    reference=response=distance=matches=word_count=first_count=0
    attempted_units_ok=all(p['attempted_units']==min(len(full[normal(p['target_text'])]),len(full[normal(p['final_text'])])) for p in x['prompts'])
    for p,attempted,final,firsts,edited in prows:
        rg,tg=graphemes(attempted),graphemes(final)
        d,m=align(rg,tg)
        reference+=len(rg);response+=len(tg);distance+=d;matches+=m
        attempted_units_ok &= p['attempted_units']==min(len(full[normal(p['target_text'])]),len(tg))
        typed_words=words(final)
        for i,target in enumerate(words(attempted)):
            attempt=firsts.get(i,typed_words[i] if i<len(typed_words) else '')
            word_count+=1
            first_count+=i not in edited and align(graphemes(target),graphemes(attempt))[0]==0
    secs=x['session']['active_seconds']
    calculated={'accuracy':100*max(0,1-distance/max(reference,response)) if reference+response else None,
                'correct_gpm':matches*60/secs if secs>=60 and reference>=100 else None,
                'first_try_accuracy':100*first_count/word_count if word_count else None}
    comparisons={k:{'reported':x['summary'][k],'recalculated':v,'matches':math.isclose(x['summary'][k],v,abs_tol=1e-8) if v is not None else x['summary'][k] is None} for k,v in calculated.items()}
    results.append({'session_id':x['session']['session_id'],'reference_graphemes':reference,'response_graphemes':response,
                    'distance':distance,'matched_graphemes':matches,'words':word_count,'first_try_words':first_count,
                    'attempted_units_match':attempted_units_ok,'comparisons':comparisons})

record={'scope':'one-off current snapshot; independent Python alignment/word scoring with .NET 8.0.31 StringInfo segmentation',
        'new_pipeline_dependency':False,'portable_audit_verifies_these_fields':False,
        'manifest_sha256':hashlib.sha256((root/'manifest.json').read_bytes()).hexdigest(),
        'all_match':all(r['attempted_units_match'] and all(c['matches'] for c in r['comparisons'].values()) for r in results),
        'input_sha256':{p.relative_to(PROJECT_ROOT).as_posix():hashlib.sha256(p.read_bytes()).hexdigest() for p in paths},
        'source_sha256':hash_outputs([Path(__file__),PROJECT_ROOT/'work/usage-score-probe/Segment.cs',
                                    PROJECT_ROOT/'work/usage-score-probe/Segment.runtimeconfig.json']),
        'segmenter_runtime':'Microsoft.NETCore.App 8.0.31, rollForward disabled; Windows',
        'investigation_source_code':{'crosscheck.py':Path(__file__).read_text(encoding='utf-8'),
                                    'Segment.cs':(PROJECT_ROOT/'work/usage-score-probe/Segment.cs').read_text(encoding='utf-8'),
                                    'Segment.runtimeconfig.json':(PROJECT_ROOT/'work/usage-score-probe/Segment.runtimeconfig.json').read_text(encoding='utf-8')},
        'results':results}
write_json(PROJECT_ROOT/'results/usage-metric-audit-v1/score-crosscheck.json',record)
print(json.dumps(record,indent=2))

using System; using System.Globalization; using System.Text.Json; using System.Collections.Generic;
class Probe { static void Main() { var values=JsonSerializer.Deserialize<string[]>(Console.In.ReadToEnd()); var all=new List<List<string>>(); foreach(var text in values) { var units=new List<string>(); var e=StringInfo.GetTextElementEnumerator(text); while(e.MoveNext()) units.Add((string)e.Current); all.Add(units); } Console.Write(JsonSerializer.Serialize(all)); } }
